origin.says: Simplified from 襖: 衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 奥 (deep) as the sound. The simplified form swaps the sound part for the simpler 夭 (young), which sounds alike: a padded coat or jacket.
礻 (altar, spirits) for the meaning plus 司 (manage) as the sound: offerings to the spirits, then the ancestral temple where they are made.

诲.def: to teach, to instruct; to encourage, to urge

origin.says: From 誨: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 每 (every) as the sound, to teach and admonish. The simplified form writes 言 as 讠.

诲.name: counsel

垦.def: to cultivate, to farm; to reclaim

origin.says: From 墾: 貇 as the sound plus 土 (earth) for the meaning, to break new ground. Simplified by dropping part of 貇, leaving 艮 (stubborn) over 土.

垦.name: break ground

陨.def: to slip, to fall; to drop; to die

origin.says: 阝 (hill, slope) for the meaning plus 员 (member) as the sound: to fall down from a height, as in a meteorite. Simplified from 隕 (員 to 员).

陨.name: fall from sky

origin.says: An old drawing of uncertain subject: a halberd, a plant, or a tool for measuring shadows. Borrowed as the tenth heavenly stem. The modern shape is only like 癶 (spread feet) over 天 (sky).
Simplified from 絢: 糸 (silk), shortened to 纟, for the meaning plus 旬 (ten days) as the sound: patterned silk, colourful and brilliant.
Simplified from 駱 (馬 became 马): 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 各 (each) as the sound: first a kind of horse, now the camel.

绞.def: intertwined; to twist, to wring; to hang a criminal

origin.says: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 交 (to cross) as the sound, strands crossing: to twist, to wring, to hang. Simplified from 絞 by writing 糸 (thread) as 纟.

绞.name: strangle cord

origin.says: 耒 (plough) for the meaning plus 巴 as the sound: a farm tool, a rake or harrow; to rake.
土 (earth) for the meaning plus 更 (change) as the sound: a low bank of earth between fields, a dike.

ety.hint: To resist 吾 by hand 扌; 吾 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 吾 (I) as the sound: to resist; today mostly to cover with the hand.

ety.hint: A person 口 wearing a robe 衣

origin.says: Early forms show 衣 (clothes) with a hand: to put on a robe. A circle, now 口, was added as the sound, and the hand turned into 土. Now mostly a surname; one source calls the top unclear.

捌.def: to split, to break open; eight (bankers' anti-fraud numeral)

ety.hint: To separate 别 by hand 扌; 别 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 别 (to separate) as the sound: to break apart; borrowed as the cheque form of eight.

捌.name: cheque eight

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 甬 (bell) as the sound: to jab or poke with the hand; a later character.
Built from 耳 (ear) and 火 (fire): one reading takes 火 as part of a shortened sound and 耳 for the meaning, another takes 火 (fire, light) for the meaning. Bright, then upright and loyal.

ety.hint: A pair 双 of ears 耳

origin.says: From 聶, three 耳 (ear) close together: ears put together to whisper. Simplification kept one 耳 and wrote the other two as 又 (hand) twice.

ety.hint: A dog 犬 surrounded by weeds 艹, 廾

origin.says: 犬 (dog) inside 茻 (thick grass, its top half 艹, its bottom half 廾): a dog hunting in the undergrowth, hence thicket, then rash. 茻 may also give the sound.

莹.def: bright, lustrous, sparkling like a gem

ety.hint: Simplified form of 瑩; fiery 火 like a gem 玉

origin.says: From 瑩: a shortened 熒 (glimmer) as the sound plus 玉 (jade) for the meaning: lustrous like jade. The 熒 top was simplified like 荧.

莹.name: gem lustre

ety.hint: A bird 鸟 covered in 冖 green 艹 feathers

origin.says: From 鶯: 鳥 (bird) for the meaning plus the top of 熒 (glowing) as the sound. The simplified form writes the fire top as 艹 (grass) over 冖 (cover), as in 荧 (glow), and 鳥 as 鸟.
origin.src: own knowledge; same pattern as 萤 and 营

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 邦 (nation) as the sound: a wooden clapper struck by night watchmen.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 同 (same) as the sound: the tung or paulownia tree.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 华 (splendid) as the sound: the birch tree. Simplified from 樺, with 華 replaced by 华.

ety.hint: A tree 木 bearing nuts 覀; compare 果

origin.says: A picture of a tree with spiky chestnut burs on top; the burs are now written like 覀 (cover) over 木 (tree). Unrelated to 要 and 票.

贾.def: merchant; to buy, to trade; surname

origin.says: 襾 (cover, written 覀) as the sound plus 贝 (shell, money) for the meaning: a merchant, to trade. Simplified from 賈 by writing 貝 as 贝.

贾.name: merchant

砰.def: bang! the sound of crashing rock

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 平 (level) as the sound: the bang of crashing rock, any loud bang.

砰.name: bang

origin.says: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 向 (toward) as the sound: a part of the day, noon, a while. A later popular form of 曏, which used 鄉 (village) as the sound.
虫 (creature) for the meaning plus 丰 (lush plant) as the sound: a mussel or clam.
虫 (creature) for the meaning plus 公 (public) as the sound: the centipede.
囗 (enclosure) for the meaning plus 甫 as sound; 甫 itself first drew a garden, so the enclosure was added to keep that sense: a garden or orchard plot.
央 (center) as the sound plus 鸟 (bird) for the meaning: the female mandarin duck. Simplified from 鴦 with 鳥 (bird) written in its short form.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 言 (speech) as the sound: words of sympathy to the bereaved, condolences.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 即 (at once) as the sound: a sound word for chirping insects and squirting.

峨.def: lofty; the name of a mountain

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 我 (I) as the sound: a lofty mountain, as in the name Emei.

峨.name: high mountain

origin.says: Simplified from 鉗: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 甘 (sweet) as the sound: metal tongs, pliers, to clamp. 金 (metal) is written in its short form 钅.
Simplified from 鉀: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 甲 (shell armor) as the sound; once 'armour', now used for the element potassium.
禾 (grain plant) for the meaning plus 央 (center) as the sound: young rice plants, seedlings. A late character.
Simplified from 筍: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 旬 (ten days) as the sound. The simplified form uses 尹 (official) instead: bamboo shoots.

倚.def: to rely on, to depend on

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 奇 (strange) as the sound: a person leaning against something, to rely on.

倚.name: prop oneself

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 奄 (to cover) as the sound: a dialect word for 'I, me'.

ety.hint: A hand 爫 fetching food from a container 臼

origin.says: 爫 (hand) above 臼 (mortar, vessel): a hand taking grain or liquid out of a vessel, to scoop, to ladle.
豸 (crouching beast) for the meaning plus 才 (talent) as the sound: the jackal or dhole, a wild dog; from that, cruel.
月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 夷 (barbarians) as the sound: the pancreas; also an old soap made from it.
From 臍: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 齊 (even) as the sound, the navel. The simplified form uses 齐 (even).
月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 农 (farming) as the sound: the thick fluid of a sore body part. Simplified from 膿, with 農 (farming) shortened to 农.
Two men kneeling face to face (the outer shape, now like 卯) around 皀 (a food vessel), which also gives the sound: nobles at a ritual feast, hence a minister. Once the same character as 鄉.
鸟 (bird) for the meaning plus 它 (snake, it) as the sound, echoing 驼 (camel): the ostrich, the camel-like bird. Simplified from 鴕.
鸟 (bird) for the meaning plus 夗 (curled up) as the sound: the male mandarin duck. Simplified from 鴛 with the short bird form.

斋.def: to fast, to abstain; a vegetarian diet

origin.says: Simplified from 齋: 齊 (even, orderly) as the sound over 示 (altar, spirits) for the meaning: purifying oneself before worship, hence fasting. The simplified form keeps 文 (pattern) from the top of 齊 and a shortened bottom that looks like 而 (and).

斋.name: fasting

ety.hint: A vertebra 人 protruding from the flesh ⺼

origin.says: First a drawing of a backbone; 月 (flesh) was added below. The drawing became the top piece 𠦬 (spine, with a 人-like centre), now read as the sound.
羊 (sheep) over 灬 (fire): a young sheep roasted over a fire, a lamb. One old reading takes the bottom as a shortened sound part instead.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 折 (bend) as the sound: the name of a winding river, and so Zhejiang province.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 勞 (toil) as the sound: fields flooded by too much rain. Simplified from 澇 like 劳.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 甫 (just now) as the sound: the shore where a river meets the water, an inlet.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 奂 (grand) as the sound: water spreading out and dispersing. Simplified from 渙, whose sound part 奐 was written more simply as 奂.

ety.hint: A stream 氵 flowing through a valley 间; 间 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 澗: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 閒/间 (gap) as the sound: a stream in a gap between mountains.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 孛 (sprouting, a comet) as the sound: a mind going against reason, 'contrary, perverse'.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 旱 (drought) as the sound: a fierce, bold temper.

ety.hint: One who freely shares 享 advice 讠; 享 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus a sound part (chún) now written like 享 (to enjoy): earnest, patient words. Simplified from 諄.
Oracle forms show 木 (wood) over 示 (altar): burning wood to ask the spirits, hence an evil spirit or curse. The top later turned into 出 (go out), which can now be read as a sound part.
女 (woman) for the meaning plus 肙 (small worm) as the sound: graceful, lovely.
女 (woman) for the meaning plus 我 (I) as the sound: a beautiful woman, as in the moon goddess Chang'e.

绢.def: a kind of thick stiff silk

origin.says: From 絹: 糸 (silk), shortened to 纟, for the meaning plus 肙 (small worm) as the sound: a thin, stiff raw silk.

绢.name: silk fabric

骏.def: an excellent horse; a noble steed

origin.says: Simplified from 駿: 馬 (horse) for the meaning plus 夋 (a walking figure) as the sound: a fine horse. The horse is written 马.

骏.name: fine steed

origin.says: 𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 㐬 (flowing, as in 流 flow) as the sound: a glossy stone, now glazed tile and glass.
𤣩 (jade, from 玉) for the meaning plus 良 (good) as the sound: a white jade-like stone.

捺.def: to press down firmly with the fingers

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 奈 (how) as the sound: to press down with the hand; also the falling-right stroke in writing.

捺.name: right sweep

焉.def: why? where? how?; strange; thereupon, then

ety.hint: A bird 鳥 with a strange head

origin.says: Taken as a fused writing of 於是 (thereupon): the 日 (sun) of 是 was dropped and 烏 (crow) cut to its lower half. The modern shape looks like 正 (straight) over a bird's lower body.

焉.name: how so

捶.def: to beat, to lash, to strike with a cane

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 垂 (droop) as the sound: to beat or pound with the hand or a stick.

捶.name: beat

埠.def: jetty, quay; port city, trade hub

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 阜 (mound) as the sound: a landing place, a port. A late character.

埠.name: wharf

捻.def: to twist or nip with the fingers

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 念 (think of) as the sound: to twist between the fingers.

捻.name: finger roll

掂.def: to heft, to weigh; to hold in the palm

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 店 (shop) as the sound: to weigh something in the palm.

掂.name: heft

掺.def: to mix, to blend, to adulterate

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 参 (join) as the sound: to mix in by hand, to blend. Simplified from 摻, with 參 shortened to 参.

掺.name: mix in

origin.says: 耳 (ear) for the meaning plus 令 (command) as the sound: to listen closely.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 夌 (to climb over) as the sound: the water caltrop, a water plant with horned nuts.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 咅 (spit) as the sound: a fragrant herb; now mostly used for its sound in 菩萨 (bodhisattva).
